_comment: SAPM Infrastructure Operations Plan — capacity, backup/restore, and disaster recovery policies for Alpha mainnet launch.
_status: Approved for Alpha mainnet launch gate

components.scalingTrigger: CPU > 70% for 2 minutes OR request queue depth > 50
components.loadTestEvidence: npm run test:load — baseline throughput and p99 latency captured in artifacts/ci-logs/load-report.json

components.note: Stateless Next.js; horizontal scale is safe with no sticky sessions required

components.scalingTrigger: Manual scale only; lifecycle controller manages provider restarts
components.note: Stateful provider lifecycle — horizontal scale requires session affinity or leader election

loadTestValidation.status: Baseline captured in CI; production-profile soak test pending hardware provisioning

statefulComponents.note: Sui fullnode replication provides inherent durability; no additional backup required for on-chain state

statefulComponents.backupFrequency: Snapshot to Walrus at end of each resolution round
statefulComponents.restoreProcedure: Replay Walrus snapshot digest through `agents/aggregator/reputation/engine.js` init path

statefulComponents.backupFrequency: KMS provides built-in replication; operator responsible for cross-region key backup per KMS policy
statefulComponents.restoreProcedure: Restore from KMS cross-region backup; re-provision agents with restored credentials

backupPolicy.restoreValidation: Restore drill must be executed in staging before each mainnet release. Evidence of successful restore must be linked in the Go/No-Go package.

disasterRecoveryPlan.rtoTarget: 4 hours (SEV-1 complete outage to service restoration)
disasterRecoveryPlan.rpoTarget: 1 resolution round for reputation state; 0 for on-chain state (blockchain is source of truth)

scenarios.detection: Kubernetes liveness probe failure + ALT-003 agent loop error rate alert
scenarios.recovery: Kubernetes restarts pod automatically; if restart budget exceeded, page SRE for manual intervention
Switch RPC endpoint to backup fullnode via network-allowlist.json env override; circuit breaker prevents cascading failures

scenarios.detection: Synthetic monitor probe failure + on-call page
scenarios.recovery: Deploy from git tag to secondary region using production-deployment-manifests/; restore reputation snapshot from Walrus; validate per runbook sections 3-5

scenarios.detection: SEV-1 alert or manual declaration by Incident Commander
scenarios.recovery: Execute rollback per docs/OPERATIONS_RUNBOOK.md#rollback-procedure; restore from last known-good git tag

disasterRecoveryPlan.drTestStatus: DR runbook and scenario procedures are documented. Live DR drill required in staging before Go/No-Go; planned for 2026-08-09 window.
